source.name: ASSOS: EQUIPE RS Jersey S11 EF (2026 EF Pro Cycling team jersey)
source.quote: A racing jersey engineered for the EF Pro Cycling Team to meet the demands of WorldTour racing.
source.note: Title sponsor. ASSOS's photos of the 2026 race jersey (front: https://cdn.assos.com.filoblu.com/rx/ofmt_webp/media/catalog/product/A/S/ASSOS_36.26.117.99_11.jpg, back: https://cdn.assos.com.filoblu.com/rx/ofmt_webp/media/catalog/product/A/S/ASSOS_36.26.117.99_12.jpg) show the EF spiral logo with 'Education' across the chest, on the middle back, and across the rear of the bib shorts.

source.note: The jersey photos (ASSOS_36.26.117.99_13.jpg and ..._41.jpg, same catalog) show the Cadillac crest and 'CADILLAC' down the sleeves. EF's own partners page (https://efprocycling.com/partners/cadillac/) confirms the partnership.

source.name: EF Pro Cycling: ASSOS X EF Pro Cycling: The future of speed is now
source.quote: ASSOS of Switzerland and EF Pro Cycling break boundaries with 2026 team kit and announce multi-year partnership
source.note: Kit manufacturer, recorded as partner per existing convention. The ASSOS star logo sits on the right chest, the rear shoulder, the left leg of the bib shorts and the shorts' rear waist (ASSOS_36.26.117.99_11/12.jpg and ASSOS_36.16.064.18_11/12.jpg on cdn.assos.com.filoblu.com); the silver shoulder/side tape repeats 'effe assos'.

summary: Title sponsors EF (Education) and EasyPost fill the chest and the upper back; Oatly's pill logo sits on both shoulders, wahoo is on the chest and a shorts thigh, POC at the collar (front and back), Cadillac down the sleeves and EasyPost on both shorts thighs. Assos makes the kit. Marked complete: Assos's product photos of the 2026 EQUIPE RS jersey and EQUIPE R bib shorts, front and back, show no other sponsor (other partners listed at efprocycling.com/partners, e.g. Cannondale and Stifel, are not on the kit).
